meta.title: Live delivery
meta.description: Incremental delivery plugin for long-running tasks: ship a working baseline first, then iterate version by version. Off by default; use /deliver to toggle. Exposes ld_begin, ld_publish, ld_status, and ld_done tools along with a status badge, stores snapshots under .live-delivery/<sessionId>/versions/, and supports idle auto-continuation with advisory time budgets.
